# Pride Purple Park Titan Hinjewadi

> Pride Purple Park Titan is an 18-tower landmark luxury residential township master-planned across 17+ prime acres on Hinjewadi-Marunji Link Road, Phase 1, Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411057. Developed by Pride Purple Group (Purple Corp).

## Project Overview & Architectural Specifications
- **Master Developer**: Pride Purple Group (28+ years track record, 30+ million sq.ft. delivered, 40,000+ happy families)
- **Land Parcel**: 17+ expansive acres within the 60-acre Park District integrated township
- **Skyline Architecture**: 18 high-rise residential towers (G+23 floors) engineered with monolithic aluminum formwork (Mivan construction)
- **Low Core Density**: Serene living with strictly 6 residences per elevator core, served by 3 high-speed elevators
- **The Raised Podium**: Pune's largest 7-acre continuous vehicle-free active podium deck, completely eliminating surface traffic
- **Championship Academies**: 5 on-site national sports and cultural academies right inside the gates:
  - Padukone School of Badminton
  - BSA Bluewater Swim Academy (Arjun Muralidharan)
  - Shiamak Davar Dance Academy
  - SportyBeans Multi-Sport Training Facility
  - Suresh Wadkar's Ajivasan Music Academy
- **Amenities**: 40+ curated indoor and outdoor lifestyle amenities including Olympic-size swimming pool, clubhouse, jogging trails, EV charging stations, and senior activity zones

## Sanctioned Configurations & Final All-Inclusive Pricing
Strictly reporting certified RERA Total Carpet Area and Final All-Inclusive Price (including 6% Stamp Duty, ₹30,000 Registration, and 5% GST):
- **2 RLK Optima**: Total Carpet 726.44 sq.ft. (67.49 m²) · Final All-Inclusive Price: ₹93,57,088*
- **2 RLK Ultima**: Total Carpet 789.54 sq.ft. (73.35 m²) with Bay Windows · Final All-Inclusive Price: ₹1,00,88,275*
- **3 RLK Optima**: Total Carpet 988.25 sq.ft. (91.81 m²) with 3 Bathrooms · Final All-Inclusive Price: ₹1,23,93,825*
- **3 RLK Ultima**: Total Carpet 1,059.87 sq.ft. (98.46 m²) with Dual Decks · Final All-Inclusive Price: ₹1,37,13,680*
- **3 RLK Grande**: Total Carpet 1,212.22 sq.ft. (112.62 m²) Palatial Layout · Final All-Inclusive Price: ₹1,64,69,830*
- **Floor Rise**: Structured @ ₹15,000 per floor from the 2nd floor onwards
